method: read-only: /proc of the running service, its /api/system status, checksums; no restart, stop, attach, patch or redeploy
root_cause: HistoryRecorder._step always includes a flush deadline last_flush + HEARTBEAT_S (10 s), but only flushes when rows or dirty segments exist. With none (no frames since start, or 10 s after the last flush once a run ends), the deadline is never advanced, the queue.get timeout is max(0, due - now) = 0 forever, and queue.get(timeout=0) returns at once without a system call: a pure user-space spin holding a core until the next state arrives. The same happens permanently after a non-retryable open failure (state 'incompatible'): the maintenance deadline stays in the past while _step returns before maintaining.
